| C-20260817-stdio-auth-from-environment | active | — | harness@26a16c2f | The MCP authorization framework applies to HTTP transports; stdio implementations SHOULD NOT follow it and should retrieve credentials from the environment instead. | https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic | vault:research/recall/research/C-20260817-stdio-auth-from-environment.md:13 |
| C-20260817-stdio-framing-rules | active | — | harness@26a16c2f | stdio framing is newline-delimited JSON-RPC with no embedded newlines; the server MUST NOT write anything to stdout that is not a valid MCP message, MAY write UTF-8 to stderr for logging, and clients SHOULD NOT treat stderr output as errors. | https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports/stdio | vault:research/recall/research/C-20260817-stdio-framing-rules.md:13 |
| C-20260817-stdio-no-server-requests | active | — | harness@26a16c2f | On stdio the server MUST NOT write JSON-RPC requests to stdout; server-to-client interactions are carried in InputRequiredResult replies instead. | https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports/stdio | vault:research/recall/research/C-20260817-stdio-no-server-requests.md:13 |
| C-20260817-subscriptions-listen-replaces-get | active | — | harness@26a16c2f | 2026-07-28 replaces the HTTP GET endpoint and resources/subscribe / resources/unsubscribe with a single subscriptions/listen long-lived POST-response stream that clients opt into by notification type. | https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/changelog | vault:research/recall/research/C-20260817-subscriptions-listen-replaces-get.md:13 |
| C-20260817-tasks-moved-to-extension | active | — | harness@26a16c2f | Experimental tasks moved out of the core protocol into an official extension io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks, replacing blocking tasks/result with polling via tasks/get plus a new tasks/update, and removing tasks/list. | https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/changelog | vault:research/recall/research/C-20260817-tasks-moved-to-extension.md:13 |
